author: @devopsdan
headline: Turned a 40-minute release checklist into one command
quote: I described the release process once; now `thor cron` runs the checklist every Friday and files the PR before I'm back from coffee.

author: throwaway_wsrl
headline: Set up Thor Agent on WSL in a lunch break
quote: install.sh on WSL just worked. By the end of lunch it had read our repo, wired up the LSP, and was fixing lint errors with me.

author: @solo_pete
headline: My inbox finally stays at zero
quote: Thor triages mail overnight, drafts replies for anything routine, and leaves me the three messages that actually need a human.

author: Mara Writes
headline: Weekly newsletter, written by a pipeline I trust
quote: It drafts from my notes, keeps my voice, and flags anything it is unsure about instead of inventing quotes.

author: u/freelance_fay
headline: Late invoices stopped being my problem
quote: Polite reminder emails, on schedule, every time. Cash flow got boring — in the best way.

author: @quant_carla
headline: Earnings digest before the market opens
quote: Every morning my dashboard has the overnight filings summarized with the numbers that matter to my positions.

author: @phd_maya
headline: Literature review that actually cites correctly
quote: It reads the papers I point at, extracts the methods, and every citation links back to the source. No hallucinated references.

author: PixelSmith
headline: Shipped a game-jam build with an agent pair-programming
quote: I designed; Thor implemented. 48 hours later we had a playable build and a clean commit history.

author: IndieHQ
headline: One launch, every platform, consistent message
quote: The changelog became the announcement post, the thread, and the newsletter blurb — all reviewed by me in one pass.

author: sre_kim
headline: Pager messages now arrive with a diagnosis attached
quote: Thor correlates the alert with the deploy and recent logs, so the page I get at 3am already says what broke and why.

author: Dana Okoye, IT Director
headline: Audit evidence collection on autopilot
quote: For the first time, the evidence pack assembled itself. My team spent the audit answering questions, not hunting screenshots.

author: jules&co
headline: The group chat has a secretary now
quote: It watches the family Discord, keeps the shared calendar honest, and reminds everyone about the school play.

author: u/homelab_hugo
headline: My agent, my hardware, my keys
quote: Docker Compose on a mini-PC with local models for the easy work. Nothing leaves the house unless I say so.

author: cost_conscious
headline: Same results, a third of the tokens
quote: Skill routing picks small models for boilerplate and the big one only for gnarly refactors. The bill dropped and I didn't change how I work.

author: @maker_maria
headline: Wrote my first plugin in an evening
quote: The plugin contract is small and honest. By midnight my internal tool was callable from chat like everything else.

author: @newbie_nate
headline: Never got past the README before. This time I did
quote: The installer set up the model, search, and voice in one command. My first conversation was useful in the first five minutes.
